```{=html}
<!-- ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
     KEY ENTRY MODAL
     ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════ -->
<div id="ws-modal-overlay" class="ws-modal-overlay" onclick="closeModal(event)">
  <div class="ws-modal" role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-labelledby="modal-title">
    <button class="ws-modal-close" onclick="closeKeyModal()" aria-label="Close">✕</button>
    <div class="ws-modal-icon">🔑</div>
    <h3 id="modal-title" class="ws-modal-title">Enter Workshop Key</h3>
    <p id="modal-track-name" class="ws-modal-track"></p>
    <input
      type="password"
      id="ws-key-input"
      class="ws-key-input"
      placeholder="Workshop key..."
      onkeydown="if(event.key==='Enter') submitKey()"
      autocomplete="off"
    />
    <p id="ws-key-error" class="ws-key-error" aria-live="polite"></p>
    <button class="ws-btn ws-btn--modal" onclick="submitKey()">Unlock →</button>
  </div>
</div>


<!-- ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
     JAVASCRIPT — key gate logic
     ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════ -->
<script>
// Config is loaded from config.json at page load so the admin
// can change keys or unlock tiers by editing that one file on GitHub.
let workshopConfig = null;
let activeProfile  = null;

// ── FIX 1: Loading state helpers ─────────────────────────
// All buttons start disabled (set in HTML above).
// removeLoadingState() re-enables them after config is fetched.
// This prevents the /docs/null/index.html race condition where
// enterTrack() was called before workshopConfig was populated.
function removeLoadingState() {
  document.querySelectorAll('.ws-btn').forEach(btn => {
    btn.disabled = false;
    btn.classList.remove('ws-btn--loading');
  });
}

async function loadConfig() {
  try {
    const res = await fetch('config.json');
    workshopConfig = await res.json();
    applyLockStates();
  } catch (e) {
    // If config.json can't be fetched (e.g. local file:// preview),
    // fall back to locked state for all non-basic profiles.
    console.warn('config.json not available — defaulting to locked state.');
  } finally {
    // ── Always re-enable buttons, whether fetch succeeded or failed
    removeLoadingState();
  }
}


function applyLockStates() {
  if (!workshopConfig) return;
  const profiles = workshopConfig.profiles;

  Object.entries(profiles).forEach(([id, cfg]) => {
    const card = document.querySelector(`[data-profile="${id}"]`);
    if (!card) return;

    if (!cfg.locked) {
      // Silently unlock — swap badge and button
      card.classList.remove('ws-card--locked');
      card.classList.add('ws-card--open');
      const badge = card.querySelector('.ws-card-badge');
      if (badge) { badge.textContent = '🟢 Open Access'; badge.className = 'ws-card-badge ws-badge--open'; }
      const btn = card.querySelector('.ws-btn');
      if (btn) {
        btn.className = 'ws-btn ws-btn--open';
        btn.textContent = 'Enter Track →';
        btn.setAttribute('onclick', `enterTrack('${id}')`);
      }
    }
  });
}


function enterTrack(profileId) {
  const cfg = workshopConfig && workshopConfig.profiles[profileId];
  // Changed docs/${profileId}/index.html to just ${profileId}/welcome.html
  const path = cfg ? cfg.path : `${profileId}/welcome.html`; 
  window.location.href = path;
}


function openKeyModal(profileId) {
  activeProfile = profileId;
  const cfg = workshopConfig && workshopConfig.profiles[profileId];

  // If admin silently unlocked, just redirect
  if (cfg && !cfg.locked) { enterTrack(profileId); return; }

  document.getElementById('modal-track-name').textContent =
    cfg ? cfg.label : profileId;
  document.getElementById('ws-key-input').value = '';
  document.getElementById('ws-key-error').textContent = '';
  document.getElementById('ws-modal-overlay').style.display = 'flex';
  setTimeout(() => document.getElementById('ws-key-input').focus(), 50);
}


function closeKeyModal() {
  document.getElementById('ws-modal-overlay').style.display = 'none';
  activeProfile = null;
}


function closeModal(event) {
  if (event.target.id === 'ws-modal-overlay') closeKeyModal();
}


function submitKey() {
  if (!activeProfile || !workshopConfig) return;
  const cfg     = workshopConfig.profiles[activeProfile];
  const entered = document.getElementById('ws-key-input').value.trim();
  const errEl   = document.getElementById('ws-key-error');

  if (entered.toUpperCase() === cfg.key.toUpperCase()) {
    const trackToEnter = activeProfile; // 1. Save the track name
    closeKeyModal();                    // 2. Close modal (sets activeProfile to null)
    enterTrack(trackToEnter);           // 3. Use the saved track name!
  } else {
    errEl.textContent = 'Incorrect key — please try again.';
    const input = document.getElementById('ws-key-input');
    input.classList.add('ws-shake');
    setTimeout(() => { input.classList.remove('ws-shake'); input.select(); }, 600);
  }
}


// Escape key closes modal
document.addEventListener('keydown', e => {
  if (e.key === 'Escape') closeKeyModal();
});


loadConfig();
</script>
```
